children: -- Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd. (NYSE and TASE: TEVA) today announced that it will host an R&D Day on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. At the R&D Day, Teva’s leadership will discuss its R&D pipeline, its near-term value-creation potential over the next five years, and Teva’s ongoing transformation into an innovative biopharma company through the Pivot to Growth strategy.
The event will take place in New York, N.Y. Presentations will begin at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time and are expected to conclude at 12:30 p.m. Eastern Time.
Due to limited capacity, in-person attendance is by invitation only. Analysts and institutional investors invited to attend will receive separate registration instructions.
For questions regarding the event, please contact Teva's Investor Relations team at
A live webcast of the event and presentation materials will be available on Teva's Investor Relations website at
An archived version of the webcast will be available within 24 hours after the end of the live event.

Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd. (NYSE and TASE: TEVA) is transforming into a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. For over 120 years, Teva’s commitment to bettering health has never wavered. From innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology to providing complex generic medicines, biosimilars and pharmacy brands worldwide, Teva is dedicated to addressing patients’ needs, now and in the future. At Teva, We Are All In For Better Health. To learn more about how, visit www.tevapharm.com.
